title: The Structure of Cycles in Projective Geometry over $\mathbb{F}_q$
summary: A classical geometric result says that every nonzero cycle of the mod-$2$ incidence map from $d$-subsets to $(d-1)$-subsets of $[n]$ has support at least $d+1$, with equality attained by the boundary of a simplex on $d+1$ vertices. We prove an analogous result for the subspace lattice of $\mathbb{F}_q^n$, determining the minimum support size of a nonzero $d$-cycle over a field $K$ of characteristic $p \mid q+1$.
